race.description: First National Bonnici & Associates Mdn Plate
race.comment: BRENIN (10) didn't figure on debut but was a sharp improver second time out at Bendigo, in the market and running a close-up second, albeit in just a field of three. Can continue to progress and draws for every chance on speed. TOMMY'S LASS (14) put in the best effort of this campaign when last seen at Seymour, grabbing third. She'd shown early ability and should take catching here. SHAMEFUL IMPULSE (13) outran their odds on debut at Bendigo on a heavy 10, getting into fifth in a strong maiden at $61. Warrants more respect now. BLOOMIN' RICH (9) is a Rich Enuff colt on debut for the Weeding yard who can run well, watch the betting.
